note: Commercially this is close to the ideal profile and clinically it is the worst fit in the batch — the same split the corpus already recorded on the Tyron Giuliani call. He is a practising dentist, which the stated ICP names almost explicitly ('or they're a physician, something along those lines'), and the refusal was confirmed by the rep's own isolation to be a belief problem rather than an affordability one, so income holds. He is not deconditioned: 85 kg, slim-limbed, formerly deadlifting 115 kg, still swimming and doing yoga weekly. Neglected_health is recorded as a match with a caveat — his metabolic health is actively and competently managed with a glucose sensor and fasting, but the strength and mobility side has gone unaddressed for 'months, years' by his own account. He misses good_to_great decisively: he has stopped deadlifting, stopped weighted squats, stopped golf, and is trying to arrest a decline he has been losing to since 38, which is recovery and preservation rather than good going to great. The finding this call reinforces is the one already in the ICP observations — the stated criteria have no clinical dimension at all, so a prospect with five active injury sites, diabetes and pain on the programme's core movement scores as a strong fit on four of five criteria.
